responsibility: Finalizes HIR type checking by resolving remaining inference variables, normalizing and erasing regions from body-local types, adjustments, obligations-derived data, and capture information, then writing the completed results into the immutable `TypeckResults` stored in the query system. It is especially responsible for final writeback after body type checking when the next trait solver is enabled: deeply normalizing body-local types and consts, reporting normalization failures, replacing unresolved terms with error types, and marking `TypeckResults` as tainted so later compiler stages do not ICE after earlier type errors.
